_FIELD_TEST_ONLY: BRANCH feat/moss-0.16-dev.8 -- DO NOT MERGE TO main-0.7.
The 'holochain' and 'hc' entries in this file are NOT the stock holochain 0.7.0
release artifacts. They are PATCHED binaries carrying the kitsune2 hello/PoK
access module plus mDNS LAN discovery, built from lightningrodlabs/holochain
branch moss-0.16 at commit cde77393bfb2059e2763cc8f8fc4f894bf0f0996
(kitsune2 branch moss-0.16, rev d8b99b09096ac495ea7152cf48f9d4a1ac3cd0a8: upstream
kitsune2 main plus the hello/PoK and mDNS work), published as the fork release
lightningrodlabs/holochain @ holochain-0.7.0-mdns.3. The `binarySources` block
below is what repoints the fetch at that release.
mdns.3 keeps HCP2P_PROTO_VER=1002, so hello.2 and every mdns.* node interoperate.
Patched nodes advertise HCP2P_PROTO_VER=1002 and reject stock peers at preflight,
so a build made from this branch CANNOT see stock Moss on the network. That is
deliberate -- it isolates the field-test cohort -- but it means every installer
handed to a tester must be built from this branch, and the release notes must say
so. See RUNBOOK-fieldtest.md.
'lair-keystore' and 'kitsune2-bootstrap-srv' are UNPATCHED. They have no
binarySources entry and therefore still come from the stock
holochain/holochain @ holochain-0.7.0 release. Do not add one.
NOTE: `yarn update-hc-checksums` regenerates this file from GitHub release assets
and will destroy this note, the binarySources block, and the patched checksums.

All ten holochain/hc checksums are from the fork release lightningrodlabs/holochain @ holochain-0.7.0-mdns.3 checksums-sha256.txt (workflow run 36604772636, holochain commit cde77393, kitsune2 rev d8b99b09), each re-hashed locally from the downloaded asset and matched.
